answered.sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.description FROM Treatments AS T1 JOIN Spa_Treatments AS T2 ON T1.treatment_id = T2.treatment_id JOIN Spa AS T3 ON T2.spa_id = T3.spa_id GROUP BY T3.spa_id, T1.name, T1.description

candidates.meaning: Find treatments that are common to all spas and their descriptions.
candidates.sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.description FROM Treatments AS T1 JOIN Spa_Treatments AS ST ON T1.treatment_id = ST.treatment_id GROUP BY T1.treatment_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ST.spa_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Spa)
